description: Solve the true Annual Percentage Rate of a loan by bisection — including upfront fees — and compare it with the nominal rate.

faqs.a: Nominal rate is the advertised rate used to compute your payment; APR adds upfront fees into the true cost of borrowing, so APR is higher whenever fees are charged.
faqs.q: APR vs nominal rate — what is the difference?

faqs.a: The APR is the monthly rate r that makes the present value of all payments equal the net cash you receive (loan amount minus upfront fees), solved numerically by bisection and annualized.
faqs.q: How is the true APR solved?

faqs.a: When fees are zero, APR equals the nominal rate exactly. Any origination or processing fee paid up front pushes the true APR above the nominal rate.
faqs.q: Why is my APR higher than the quoted rate?

howto: Enter the loan amount, upfront fees, nominal rate and term in months.
The tool bisects the present-value equation to find the true APR.
Compare the APR against the nominal rate and your monthly payment.
title: APR Calculator
